user.title: Add Voice Satellite
user.description: Choose what to configure. External Conversation Service stores one shared External Transport connection; it is not a physical Satellite.

satellite.title: Voice Satellite
satellite.description: Create a virtual Assist satellite for a browser tablet running Voice Satellite.

data_description.name: A descriptive name for this tablet (e.g. Kitchen Tablet, Entrance Tablet).

external_service.title: External Conversation Service
external_service.description: This stores the External Transport connection once. Satellites and text conversations select one of its conversation profiles; do not put this token in a Satellite profile.

data_description.external_transport_token: The transport service bearer token. It is stored only in this service entry.
data_description.external_transport_verify_tls: Leave enabled unless the server uses a deliberately trusted private certificate.
data_description.external_transport_ready_timeout: How long to wait for the service to accept a session.
data_description.profile_name: A friendly name shown when choosing this conversation agent.
data_description.tool_profile: An exact trusted profile name from the server configuration, such as home-generic. It is not an individual tool name and is not auto-discovered; copy it from voice-tools.json.

abort.already_configured: A satellite with this name already exists.

error.external_transport_credentials_incomplet: Set both the external transport URL and token, or leave both blank.

init.title: External conversation profile
init.description: A profile is a named, reusable policy for one External Conversation Service. Server policy remains authoritative.

data_description.profile_name: Friendly name shown when selecting the conversation agent.
data_description.tool_profile: Exact profile name configured in the External Transport server, such as home-generic. It is not auto-discovered or validated here; copy it from voice-tools.json. This cannot grant tools by itself.
data_description.initial_prompt: Optional profile-specific instruction. Leave blank to use the server default.
data_description.initial_voice: Optional provider voice override for audio Satellites. Leave blank for the server default; it has no effect for text-only conversations.
data_description.requested_tools: Optional comma- or newline-separated exact tool names from the server tool configuration. They are not auto-discovered or validated here. Leave blank to use the complete server-approved profile. This can only restrict access; wildcards are not allowed.

error.invalid_tool_profile: Enter a valid trusted server tool profile name.
error.invalid_requested_tools: Requested tools must be unique exact names; wildcards are not allowed.

service.title: Reconfigure External Conversation Service
service.description: Update the shared External Transport connection. Leave the bearer token blank to retain the existing token.

data_description.external_transport_token: Leave blank to keep the existing secret. Enter a value only to replace it.
data_description.external_transport_verify_tls: Leave enabled unless the server uses a deliberately trusted private certificate.
data_description.external_transport_ready_timeout: How long Home Assistant waits for the service to accept a session.

init.title: Choose External Conversation Service
init.description: Choose the shared service that holds the External Transport URL and bearer token. You will choose one of that service's conversation profiles next.

data_description.conversation_service_entry_id: Select Loki1 Pipecat for the deployed Pipecat External Transport service.

profile.title: Choose Conversation Profile
profile.description: Choose the policy/profile this Satellite will use with the selected service.

data_description.conversation_profile_id: Select the profile configured for this service, such as Pipecat External Conversation.

abort.invalid_profile_assignment: The selected service or conversation profile is no longer available.

error.invalid_profile_assignment: Select a valid service and a profile belonging to that service.
